user.title: RoomMind
user.description: Set up RoomMind for room climate control. You set up the rooms afterwards in the RoomMind panel in the sidebar.

init.title: RoomMind options
init.description: Configure how RoomMind behaves while vacation mode is active.

data_description.vacation_action: "Setback" heats to the vacation temperature. "Off" disables active heating (frost protection only); cooling continues to track eco cool.
data_description.vacation_frost_temp: Lowest temperature kept while heating is off during vacation.
data_description.idle_off_after_minutes: When a room stays comfortable, hold setback this long, then fully turn the device off. 0 disables (pure setback). Auto-recovers when heating/cooling is needed again.

confirm_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant?
confirm_restart.description: RoomMind {version} is installed, but Home Assistant is still running the old version. The update is done after a restart.

deprecated_entities.title: RoomMind entities to replace
deprecated_entities.description:
Each room now has one climate entity (`climate.roommind_` plus the room ID) that shows and controls the room: target temperature, comfort/eco presets, mode and what RoomMind is doing right now. The old per-room entities keep working for now but will be removed in a future release. These are still referenced directly by automations or scripts:

{entities}

What to use instead:
- target temperature sensor → the target temperature of the climate entity
- mode sensor → its `hvac_action`
- override entity → `climate.set_temperature` or a preset on the climate entity (holds until the next schedule change, preset Schedule (`none`) returns to the schedule)

This notice goes away once nothing uses them any more (checked when Home Assistant starts).
